metadata.description: A collection of Claude Code plugins for cloud development and IoT

plugins.name: gcp-iot
plugins.description: Google Cloud Platform IoT development toolkit for ESP32 sensors, Cloud Run backends, Pub/Sub messaging, and Firebase frontends

plugins.name: agentboard
plugins.description: AgentBoard AI project management toolkit — structured phase-based workflow with codegraph and RAG companion tools

plugins.name: expert-dev-tools
plugins.description: An end-to-end engineering lifecycle for Claude Code: packages the Expert-series skills and adds a gated spec → architecture → plan → implement → review → ground-truth → closeout workflow that runs the phases, operates independent-review gates to a binary PASS, enforces anti-fabrication and diagnosis-before-routing, and involves the owner only at defined decision points.
